_about: Item stats cards whose 'from' number in Valve's notes is not what the previous patch's items.txt has (owner 2026-11-21: "число «было» на карточке характеристик предмета сверяется с файлами прошлого патча"). Only checked cases live here: tools/patchgen/post_notes._postprocess_valve_card_errors puts the files' number on the card and a red-glowing tag with Valve's words on hover; tests/test_valve_error.py fails on any card mismatch not listed (scripts/audit/audit_card_values.py).

7.42.why: items.txt item_crimson_guard bonus_armor 6 (7.41f) -> 5 (7.42); notes DOTA_Patch_7_42_item_crimson_guard_4 'Armor increased from +4 to +5'
